findings.title: Removed public findMany() method breaks callers
findings.body: The previous InsightsBookingService exposed a findMany(findManyArgs) method that combined conditions and queried via Prisma's typed API. This PR removes it in favor of getBaseConditions(), but any existing callers of service.findMany(...) elsewhere in the codebase (e.g., insights routers/handlers) will fail to compile or break at runtime. There's no deprecation shim or migration of callers shown in this diff; if callers still invoke findMany, this is a breaking API change not covered by the test updates.

findings.title: Caching behavior tests removed
findings.body: The previous test suite included a 'Caching' describe block verifying that getAuthorizationConditions() and getFilterConditions() cache their results across repeated calls. This PR deletes those tests entirely without replacement, reducing coverage of the memoization logic (cachedAuthConditions/cachedFilterConditions) that still exists in insightsBooking.ts. Regressions in caching (e.g., accidentally rebuilding conditions) would no longer be caught by tests.

findings.title: Loss of findMany integration test coverage
findings.body: The final integration test previously exercised the public findMany() API end-to-end with typed Prisma where-clauses. It was replaced with a raw $queryRaw test against getBaseConditions(). If findMany is still used elsewhere, there is no integration test left verifying it works correctly with the new Prisma.sql-based conditions.
